sectors.name: Crypto & Digital Assets
themes: Indonesia's crypto adoption is structurally driven by a young, mobile-first population and rising fintech penetration, making local exchange volumes a leading indicator for sustained sector moves.
Regulatory clarity under Bappebti and the shift toward a formal digital asset framework lowers tail risk, attracting institutional participation that historically amplifies rallies in this market.
Global liquidity cycles and US ETF flows remain the dominant external driver, so Indonesian crypto assets trade as high-beta proxies to BTC and ETH rather than on domestic fundamentals.
sectors.ai: Rotate into HASH and UNI for momentum, but treat the rally as tactical—global crypto beta is up without Indonesia-specific catalysts, so size positions for a 2-4 week window and take profits into strength. Watch for local exchange volume spikes or regulatory headlines to confirm sustainability; otherwise, fade the laggards (ADA, FIL) and keep cash dry for a pullback entry.
